recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.version to be independently searchable outside the specification-version composite, handle that through a new or reopened Jira because later applied history intentionally removed that standalone parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-41250 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 technical correction asking to add a DeviceDefinition 'version' search parameter because DeviceDefinition-specification-version referenced 'version' as a composite component and no such search parameter existed.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in commit 6b5f81cc671e36964883ec7faf5e4be7159fbb47, which added DeviceDefinition-version for DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.version; the Jira comment later identified merge commit 5e70ad56d965beb54173ec8f6d8889e5e7658015 as the build integration path.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-40503 added the current DeviceDefinition-version parameter for DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion.value, FHIR-51646 removed the standalone conformsTo.version search parameter because specification-version is the intended search surface for specification plus version, and FHIR-53212 made the relevant R6 DeviceDefinition search parameters normative/active.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source contains DeviceDefinition-specification-version with component definition 'version' and an active DeviceDefinition-version token parameter, and re-adding a separate conformsTo-version parameter would conflict with the later Applied FHIR-51646 cleanup.
